title: Read repository content
responsibility: Reads Git output, resolves commit revisions and retrieves tracked file names or text.

inputs.name: gitFiles.root
inputs.description: The repository directory that gitFiles passes to Git with -C for both the revision lookup and the tracked-file listing. The code does not validate it, so a directory that is not a Git repository makes the promise reject.

inputs.name: gitFiles.revision
inputs.description: The revision, such as a branch, tag or commit name, that gitFiles resolves to a commit before listing its files. gitRevision refuses an empty value, a value longer than 300 characters and a value containing a null character with 'Invalid revision.'

inputs.name: gitRead.root
inputs.description: The repository directory that gitRead passes to Git with -C before the Git arguments. The code does not validate it, so Git failures for that directory reject the promise.

inputs.name: gitRead.args
inputs.description: The Git arguments placed after -C and the root directory, one array element per argument, run directly through execFile without a shell. The helper does not restrict commands, so callers must choose read-only arguments when a read is intended.

inputs.name: gitRevision.root
inputs.description: The repository directory that gitRevision passes to Git with -C when it resolves the revision. The code does not validate it, so Git failures for that directory reject the promise.

inputs.name: gitRevision.revision
inputs.description: The revision to resolve as a commit; it defaults to HEAD only when the argument is omitted. Empty strings, values longer than 300 characters and values containing a null character are refused with 'Invalid revision.'

inputs.name: gitText.root
inputs.description: The repository directory that gitText passes to Git with -C for both the revision lookup and the git show read. The code does not validate it, so Git failures for that directory reject the promise.

inputs.name: gitText.revision
inputs.description: The revision that gitText resolves to a commit before reading the file. Empty strings, values longer than 300 characters and values containing a null character are refused by gitRevision with 'Invalid revision.'

inputs.name: gitText.path
inputs.description: The repository-relative path of the file to read, used as '<commit>:<path>' in git show. Paths that start with '/', contain a '..' segment or contain a null character are refused with 'Unsafe source path.'; the code does not check other values, including an empty string.

outputs.name: gitRead
outputs.description: A promise for the standard output of the Git command, returned without trimming; Git runs with GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT set to 0 so it does not prompt on the terminal. The promise rejects when Git fails or its output exceeds the 64,000,000-byte maxBuffer limit.

outputs.name: gitRevision
outputs.description: A promise for the full commit name printed by git rev-parse --verify, with surrounding whitespace removed; in a SHA-1 repository it is a 40-character lowercase hexadecimal name.

outputs.name: gitFiles
outputs.description: A promise for the tracked paths listed by git ls-tree -rz --name-only at the resolved commit, relative to root, split on NUL with empty entries removed so names with spaces or newlines are kept intact. When root is a subdirectory, only entries beneath it are listed.

outputs.name: gitText
outputs.description: A promise for the file text at the resolved commit, returned without trimming. Text whose UTF-8 byte length is over 2,000,000 bytes makes the promise reject with 'Source file too large.'

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with the message 'Invalid revision.' by gitRevision, and so by gitFiles and gitText, when the revision is empty, longer than 300 characters or contains a null character.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with the message 'Unsafe source path.' by gitText when the path starts with '/', has a '..' segment or contains a null character.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with the message 'Source file too large.' by gitText when the text's UTF-8 byte length is over 2,000,000 bytes.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejected by gitRead when the Git process cannot start, exits with a failure or its output exceeds the 64,000,000-byte maxBuffer limit, which also makes gitFiles, gitRevision and gitText reject.
